text: A long, cool, mostly lactic set gives a soft, acidic, creamy paste with live lactic bacteria that is never cooked or pressed. If left longer, natural moulds on the surface turn it creamy under the rind and give it a more pronounced taste.

steps.note: Set lactic with animal rennet, and an optional local natural milk or whey starter.
Cylindrical plastic moulds, 10–14 cm across, 250–400 g.
Fresco is ready after 3–10 d, affinato after more than 10 d, when natural moulds bloom on the surface.
